services.summary: Floral planning and design for weddings and private celebrations.

packages.name: Essential
packages.description: The Essential Package is designed for smaller celebrations that need coordinated professional floral design without extensive venue styling.
packages.note: This package is appropriate for smaller weddings and events with a focused floral plan.

packages.name: Signature
packages.description: The Signature Package provides more complete floral coordination throughout the ceremony and reception.
packages.note: This package is designed for clients who want a consistent floral look throughout multiple areas of the event.

packages.name: Full-Service
packages.description: The Full-Service Package provides complete floral and event design support for larger or more detailed celebrations.
packages.note: The exact scope depends on the venue, event schedule, floral design, and client requirements.
